name: Grimoire: Clank Lorebook Importer
meta: Browser extension · Brave / Chromium · Manifest V3
desc: A custom extension for clank.world that turns bulk lorebook entry into a small ritual. Drop structured .md or .txt files and Grimoire provisions, fills, and saves dozens of memory entries automatically — using Chrome DevTools Protocol injection so reactive fields never drop or cross-wire data.
caption: Grimoire during an automated import
codeBlock:
Title: Dunmoor Valley
Keywords: region, valley, Millstone Valley
Content: The rural farming region containing...

Title: Fria
Keywords: Queen of Chaos, protagonist
Content: The main character...
stack: How to install
1. Download the .zip and extract it somewhere safe (Desktop or Documents)
2. Open brave://extensions or chrome://extensions
3. Turn Developer mode ON (top right)
4. Click Load unpacked → select the extracted clank-lorebook-importer folder
5. Done — open your Lorebook on clank.world; the UI appears bottom-right
Built with
manifest.json — Manifest V3, CDP debugger permission
background.js — OS-level Input.insertText + coordinate clicks via CDP
content.js — drop-zone parser, field traversal, save confirmation
Adjustable ritual pace + emergency STOP RITUAL kill switch
hint: Extract → brave://extensions or chrome://extensions → Developer mode → Load unpacked

name: Obelisk: Clank Layout Builder
meta: Browser extension · Brave / Chromium · Manifest V3
desc: A visual layout and component builder for Clank.world character profiles. Obelisk adds a 47-tool studio directly to the Character Edit page, letting creators build styled sections, character UI, lore blocks, media embeds, fake widgets, interactive components and more through configurable live previews — then insert the finished result straight into the About editor.
caption: Obelisk 2.0 creator workspace
codeBlock: [ OBELISK ENGINE ONLINE ] // EDIT MODE DETECTED
stack: How to install
1. Download the .zip and extract it somewhere safe (Desktop or Documents)
2. Open brave://extensions or chrome://extensions
3. Turn Developer mode ON (top right)
4. Click Load unpacked → select the extracted clank-layout-builder folder
5. Done — open any Character Edit page on clank.world and Obelisk will appear
What is inside
47 tools covering layouts, character presentation, lore, themed text, media, social/profile components and interactive widgets
Live previews for customizing components before inserting them into the profile
Search, Favorites, Recently Used tools, accent customization and persistent settings
Interactive tools including Spinning Photo Plane and Interactive Hotspot Image
Media tools including SoundCloud, Sketchfab, cinematic GIFs, tracklists and holographic cards
Obelisk 2.0 rebuild
content.js is now a small application bootstrap instead of containing the entire extension
Core systems are separated into storage, modal, fonts, controllers, panel UI and metadata modules
All 47 tools are organized into dedicated tool groups for easier maintenance and future additions
Legacy Photo Plane support remains available for older Obelisk-generated components
hint: Extract → brave://extensions or chrome://extensions → Developer mode → Load unpacked

name: Furina: Clank Chat Atelier
meta: Browser extension · Brave / Chromium · Manifest V3 · Clank.world roleplay workspace
desc: Furina transforms Clank chat into a customizable roleplay workspace. Version 1.3 introduces a selective Continuity Vault, smarter memory injection, Director Mode 2.0, story and scene management, message capture tools, Phantom and Visual Novel layouts, cinematic presentation, profile customization, and a built-in Guidebook—while retaining the themes, wallpapers, ambience, typography, stickers, effects, and sharing tools from earlier releases.

previewImages.caption: A Clank chat customized with Furina
previewImages.alt: Example Clank chat customized with a Furina theme

previewImages.caption: The Furina workspace panel
previewImages.alt: Furina Clank Chat Atelier workspace panel

codeBlock:
chrome://extensions
Developer mode → ON
Load unpacked → select the extracted Furina folder
stack: How to install
1. Download Furina-Clank-Chat-Atelier-1.3.0.zip and extract it somewhere you plan to keep it
2. Open brave://extensions or chrome://extensions
3. Turn Developer mode ON
4. Click Load unpacked and select the extracted Furina folder
5. Open a chat on clank.world — Furina's launcher will appear on supported chat routes
New in Furina 1.3 — Continuity
The Continuity Vault stores character facts, relationships, world rules, inventory, conditions, open threads, and other details Clank should remember
Relevant memories are selected by names, aliases, keywords, present characters, priority, and scope instead of sending the entire Vault every turn
A context budget and exact injection preview show what Furina will attach before anything is sent
Remember complete messages, selected passages, or quick facts; review suggestions through the Memory Inbox before saving them
Director Mode 2.0
Give one-time direction from the composer, queue future story beats, apply control guards, and define what each character knows, suspects, or must not know
Director diagnostics reveal active guards, matched knowledge, selected memories, queued cues, and the final Furina context
All guidance remains local and user-controlled—Furina improves continuity through structured reminders rather than changing Clank's backend memory
Story and scene intelligence
Track the current location, time, cast, objective, threat, conditions, weather, mood, and scene notes
End scenes with editable recaps, build a timeline, show a Previously On summary, capture scene snapshots, and export or restore a Story Bible
Bookmarks, chapter dividers, conversation search, response-style presets, and message-level Remember actions make long chats easier to navigate
Layouts and immersion
Switch between the standard chat, experimental Phantom presentation, and a Visual Novel layout with speaker-aware portraits and a dialogue backlog
Scene title cards, transitions, atmosphere presets, cinematic screenshot mode, Reader Mode, and Focus Mode provide presentation without changing the original chat data
The new Grand Premiere plays once for Furina 1.3; an optional shorter Encore can welcome users on later visits
Customization retained and expanded
Global or per-conversation themes with solid, gradient, image and direct MP4/WebM video backgrounds
Separate assistant/user bubbles, glass effects, textures, borders, shadows, typography, avatar frames and color grading
Animated gradients, edge glow, message entrance effects, particles, corner ornaments, separators and other optional cosmetic layers
Fullscreen backgrounds now cover the entire Clank page, including the areas that remained exposed in 1.2
Draggable stickers, rain and atmosphere effects, direct audio, SoundCloud and YouTube ambience, theme sharing, Full Setup portability, diagnostics, and scoped Advanced CSS remain available
Furina 1.3 also includes customization for the Clank user profile page
Languages and help
The interface now supports English, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese, Romanian, Japanese, and Hindi
Automatic mode follows the browser language when a matching translation exists and safely falls back to English
The built-in Guidebook explains Director, Memory, Continuity, and Story tools with practical workflows for users who want a simpler starting point
hint: Extract → brave://extensions or chrome://extensions → Developer mode → Load unpacked

name: Daedalus: Clank Character Forge
meta: Browser extension · Brave / Chromium · Manifest V3 · Clank.world character creation IDE
desc: A full character-creation workspace for Clank.world. Daedalus adds persistent local projects, autosave and recovery, raw and structured prompt builders, reusable AI & roleplay rules, dialogue and scene tools, initial-message management, templates, fragments, inspection, Clank sync, project variants, notes, backups, and more — then applies the finished work back into Clank's normal creation form when you're ready.

previewImages.caption: Daedalus project and roleplay tooling
previewImages.alt: Daedalus project and roleplay rule tools

codeBlock:
https://www.clank.world/create
Open Daedalus → build locally → inspect → Apply to Clank
stack: How to install
1. Download Daedalus-Clank-Character-Forge-1.0.0.zip and extract it somewhere you plan to keep it
2. Open brave://extensions or chrome://extensions
3. Turn Developer mode ON
4. Click Load unpacked and select the extracted Daedalus folder
5. Open https://www.clank.world/create — the Daedalus launcher appears on the character creation page
Projects, drafts & recovery
Create multiple local character projects with automatic saving, recovery snapshots, project variants, individual import/export, private project notes, and full Daedalus backup/restore
Work safely inside Daedalus first; nothing is pushed into Clank's creation form until you explicitly apply it
Character workspace
Use a large raw Character Prompt editor or the structured Builder for identity, appearance, personality, behavior, voice, relationships, backstory, goals, and roleplay rules
Reorder Builder sections, use prompt outlines, Find & Replace, Focus mode, character-limit counters, and quick {{char}}/{{user}} insertion
Quick-start templates are included for original characters, fandom/canon characters, horror, romance, RPG companions, villains, ensembles, and narrator/game-master setups
AI & Roleplay Rules Studio

Build reusable behavior and immersion rules with editable presets for immersive RP, cinematic narration, horror, slow-burn romance, adventure/RPG, slice of life, action, mystery, ensemble casts, fantasy, sci-fi, historical roleplay, comedy, and more
Mix presets, add individual rules, edit everything, or create your own reusable custom-rule library
Dialogue, scenes & introductions
Dialogue has its own raw editor and structured example builder with named situations and {{user}}/{{char}} exchanges
Scene Builder organizes location, time, atmosphere, situation, goals, conflict, known information, hidden information, and scene-specific rules before compiling the final Scene Prompt
Initial Message Manager supports multiple labeled intros with duplicate, reorder, delete, counters, and synchronization back to Clank
Fragments, Inspector & Clank sync
Save reusable prompt Fragments for Character, Dialogue, or Scene and build your own personal library

Inspector reports Errors, Warnings, and Suggestions for limits, malformed variables, unfinished placeholders, missing fields, repeated sections, unsynced rules, and other common creation issues — without pretending there is one universal quality score
Overview shows publish readiness and whether Character, Dialogue, Scene, and Initial Messages match the live Clank form; apply sections individually or use Apply All
Import from Clank can pull an already-started creation form into the active Daedalus project
Presentation
ChatGPT-inspired dark theme by default, plus a persistent light theme and dedicated extension icons
